why: Creator Camp requires asset/entity/output rights status across media, territories, languages, terms and adaptation scopes. Content Universe provenance alone cannot answer clearance.
Master canon, public serial and commercial edition must be distinct versioned artifacts with release evidence and exact asset membership.
Creator Camp scene purpose/reader-state/required evidence should compile into CreativeOS PromptManifest/SceneGraph and then concrete ShotManifest(s).
My Creators has a concrete shot contract; CreativeOS has SceneGraph. A deterministic bridge prevents duplicate story/render schemas.
Long generation jobs need resumable stage/unit/output/attempt/error state and partial-failure semantics.
Local model/checkpoint/LoRA/dataset/custom-node licenses need machine-enforced production gates, not only provenance notes.
My Creators DryRunBackend and future ComfyUI adapter should implement CreativeOS ProviderBackend rather than invent a second runtime API.
IDs, enums and versioned contracts must be importable by all three repos without source copying.
Option/license/assignment, medium, territory, term, adaptation and release relationships need explicit graph semantics.
Creator Camp treats audience/commercial/industry evidence as progression stages; Content Universe should ingest these as evidence feeding project decisions.
The forensic system must represent unavailable external evidence without inventing content and later attach retrieved bodies to the same checkpoint.
The v5 master/groups protocol is reproducible in the artifact build, but not yet a GitHub CI/release job with signed/tagged outputs.
Source authority is documented, but claims/capabilities are not yet machine-linked to exact source artifacts/savepoints/commits.
Creator Camp, CreativeOS/Content Universe, and My Creators still need one importable versioned schema/identifier package to avoid contract copying.
